codotchi.background.description: Background theme for the pet canvas.

codotchi.petSize.description: Controls the overall display size of the pet sprite. 'Large' uses a more detailed 24ÃƒÆ’Ã¢â‚¬â€32 pixel grid for every sprite type.

codotchi.reducedMotion.description: Disable all pet animations (walking, jumping, reaction effects). The pet is drawn statically at the centre of the stage. Also respects the OS-level prefers-reduced-motion setting.

codotchi.devModeEnabled.description: Check to enable developer mode. Requires the developer passcode to also be set correctly. In developer mode the pet cannot die (health is floored at 1), it ages faster, and high scores are not recorded.

codotchi.developerPasscode.description: Developer passcode. Also requires 'Developer Mode Enabled' (codotchi.devModeEnabled) to be checked to activate dev mode.

codotchi.characterPasscode.description: Hidden character passcode. Enter the correct passcode to unlock a secret character on the next hatch.

codotchi.devModeAgingMultiplier.description: Aging speed multiplier applied when developer mode is active. Default: 10 (10ÃƒÆ’Ã¢â‚¬â€ faster than normal).

codotchi.devModeHealthFloor.description: Minimum health value enforced when developer mode is active. Default: 1 (pet cannot die). Set to 0 to allow the pet to die normally even in dev mode ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â‚¬Â useful for testing the death flow.

codotchi.aiMode.description: AI mode: suppress idle-timer resets from document changes, cursor movement, and tab switches ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â‚¬Â the three events an AI coding agent fires. Window focus and mouse movement still reset the timer normally. Enable this when you are using an AI agent to avoid the agent's edits keeping your pet perpetually active.

codotchi.idleResetOnDocumentChange.description: Reset the idle timer when any document is changed (keystrokes, AI agent edits, etc.). Suppressed automatically when codotchi.aiMode is enabled.

codotchi.idleResetOnCursorMovement.description: Reset the idle timer when the text editor cursor moves or the selection changes. Suppressed automatically when codotchi.aiMode is enabled.

codotchi.idleResetOnTabSwitch.description: Reset the idle timer when the active editor tab changes. Suppressed automatically when codotchi.aiMode is enabled.

codotchi.idleResetOnWindowFocus.description: Reset the idle timer when the VS Code window gains focus (e.g. you switch back to VS Code from another app). Never suppressed by aiMode.

codotchi.idleResetOnMouseMovement.description: Reset the idle timer when the mouse moves inside the Codotchi sidebar panel (throttled to once per 30 seconds). Never suppressed by aiMode.

codotchi.perWorkspacePet.description: Give each workspace its own independent pet. When enabled, state is stored in a workspace-specific file derived from the workspace path. On first enable the current shared pet is copied to the workspace file as the starting point. When disabled, all workspaces share one global pet.

codotchi.tokenCostSources.description: Which sources contribute to the 'Today's Token Cost' bubble. 'claudeCode' and 'openCode' report a dollar cost from local usage logs. 'copilot' reports a GitHub Copilot premium-request quota percentage (no API key needed ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â‚¬Â you'll be prompted to sign in to GitHub via VS Code's built-in authentication the first time). Select any combination, e.g. just ['copilot'], or all three to show everything at once.

codotchi.leaderboard.livePush.description: When enabled via the sidebar toggle button, pushes your pet's current age to the leaderboard hourly while it is alive. Requires a GitHub sign-in (prompted on first push).
